issues.title: As someone trialling use of Serge I wish to be able to download data from hosted instance in order to retain value
issues.body:
The heroku hosted instance is a great facility for experimenting with Serge.

But, it's unfortunate that any data created in Heroku will be lost when the instance gets wiped/recreated.

If Game Admins were able to download a zip of the `db` folder, then they could commit that data to the branch, and the new data will then be present in that branch.

Note: I _think_ we need to download the whole `db` folder since we need the `all-wargames` to know which wargames are present, and the `message_types` file  to see any new message templates.

Since this isn't a player-facing functionality I'm happy to be relaxed about the UI.

I propose we have a `Download all data` button to the right of `Clear wargames` in the UI below.  Clicking the button will cause `node` to zip up the `packages/server/db` folder, and immediately start to download it.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/146541826-f2f7161c-ae5a-487c-8192-6ce148fc36d6.png)
